items.description: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，彭博社北京时间今日援引 The Information 报道称，字节跳动在致投资者信中表示， 该企业计划进行新一轮 60 亿美元股票回购 。 字节跳动此轮回购价为每股 241.35 美元，对应 4,000 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2.67 万亿元人民币） 的整体估值。 这一数额相较一年前上轮回购时的水平高出 20% 。 知情人士透露，字节跳动还提议将“上市或授予外部股东出售全部持股的权利”的截止日期推迟四年至 2030 年 12 月 11 日；该企业还在文件中详细描述了向 AI 部门员工提供总计 3 亿股与 AI 业务价值挂钩的股份的计划。

items.description: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，晶圆级 AI 芯片企业 Cerebras 当地时间昨日在 2026Q3 财报电话会议上宣布， 其成功与 Microsoft（微软）签署协议 ，获得继 AWS 和 Oracle 后的第三家超大规模云计算客户。 该企业 2026Q3 实现了约 2.3 亿美元的核心总收入，同比增长 20%；其中云服务及其它占到 1.45 亿美元，同比增长 272%。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，该企业剩余履约义务为 261 亿美元。 Cerebras 预计其 2026 全年核心营收为 9.4~9.6 亿美元、核心毛利率 42~44%、核心营业利润率 8~10%。其已确保到 2027 年交付 700MW 数据中心容量，并正通过多项合作关系提升产能。

items.description: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.author: Amanda Silberling
items.content: Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security. U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported. The story took a sudden new turn on Wednesday. items.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.description: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan
items.content: In its third-quarter earnings call Thursday, the neocloud company Nebius laid out $40 billion in planned spending for 2027, far more than Wall Street had expected. It’s an ambitious plan, but it rests on a string of planned projects that are already starting to show cracks. Nebius plans to fund the buildout by relying on customer pre-payments and loans backed by customer contracts — essentially using the future value of its data centers to finance their construction. But that can be a risky strategy if those projects get bogged down by delays or cancellations. “Building at this scale is hard, and delays are part of our industry right now,” CEO Arkady Volozh said during Thursday’s earnings call. “We are not immune.” The earnings announcement comes on the heels of reports that Microsoft is cooling on neocloud deals that aren’t delivering on time. That’s a problem for companies like Nebius, whose financing strategy is becoming more dependent on repayments. Because if it can’t get to capacity on time, it will keep piling on costs while revenues slip. Nebius’ contract with Microsoft is worth up to $19.4 billion, but it’s already letting deadlines slip. items.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
items.description: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: Google Search is getting better at understanding complicated questions, including those with multiple parts, highly specific requests, or confusing typos. The updates are coming via the company’s newly released Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, which Google claims is its “biggest model improvement to Search yet.” While Google’s frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, are best at deep reasoning for hard problems, Hydrogen is designed for fast execution across a variety of agentic workflows, or tasks in which an AI carries out multiple steps on its own, the company explained in an announcement. The idea behind the model’s release is that using the most powerful model isn’t always needed — sometimes a faster, cheaper, and reasonably smart one will do. Google says Hydrogen completes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash, its previous fast model, but it’s still pretty smart, even beating the more powerful Gemini 4 Argon on one broad intelligence benchmark, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , at its default high thinking level. In Search, Hydrogen brings several improvements, including a better understanding of user intent, the ability to offer more helpful links and visual responses, and better answers across the different languages supported by Google’s AI Mode. In terms of intent, Google says Hydrogen can handle more nuanced and complicated questions more quickly. items.description: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.
items.author: Lauren Forristal
items.content: Nectar , an AI-powered operating system for marketing, is launching a new AI agent designed to take a lot of the manual work out of influencer marketing, from finding the right creators to contacting them, managing partnerships, and tracking results. Founded by sisters Misbah and Farah Uraizee, both former Meta employees, Nectar came out of stealth last year and uses AI agents to help brands manage social media, customer conversations, content moderation, creator partnerships, and competitor research. Announced Thursday, its new “Creator Agent” can search for creators, check their content and brand partnerships, send personalized messages, coordinate collaborations, and monitor how campaigns perform. Instead of having marketing teams spend weeks scrolling through social media, building spreadsheets, and sending individual DMs, Nectar wants its agent to handle much of that work automatically. Nectar joins other companies introducing agentic AI assistants designed to automate influencer outreach, including Aspire and GRIN . The launch also comes as more brands turn to creators to reach customers. U.S. spending on creator advertising is expected to reach $44 billion in 2026, according to the Interactive Advertising Bureau .
